```{julia}
#| label: setup

include(joinpath(@__DIR__, "..", "_shared", "setup.jl"))
require_summaries([:sir_pois5, :sir_reg6])
```

## The model

The shared cell of DESIGN §E.5: every line outside the `# --- NBM vignette` section and the `# back end` line is
identical on the mirrored EdgeBasedModels.jl page E01. A Quarto cell shows only its last value, and `display` of a
plot inside a cell is not captured (Plots sends it to a GR window), so the cell ends with `comparisonplot` and
keeps the `compare` table as `tab`, which is printed below.

```{julia}
#| label: shared-cell
#| fig-cap: "Pairwise model against the committed NetworkOutbreaks ensemble (spread band q2.5–q97.5 of the runs; residual panel: mean band ±1.96 SE)."
using NetworkEpiCore, NetworkOutbreaks, Catalyst, Plots
sir = @reaction_network sir begin
    @parameters τ γ
    τ, S + I --> 2I        # contact: per-contact (per-edge) rate τ; S converted, I unchanged
    γ, I --> R             # node-local transition
end
model = contact_model(sir)          # prints the typing report (B.1)
sc    = scenario(:sir_pois5)        # Poisson(5), τ = 1/6, γ = 1/4, 1% seeds in I, t ∈ [0, 60]
@assert isequivalent(model, sc.model)
ref   = scenario_summary(sc)        # committed NO ensemble: N = 10⁴, 200 runs, fresh graph per run
# --- NBM vignette ---------------------------------------------------------------
using NodeBasedModels
sys   = node_based(model, sc.network)                      # low level
sysF  = generate_pairwise(sir_model(), sc.network, default_closure(sc.network); cumulative = true)  # factory
@assert vector_fields_equal(symbolic_ode(sys), symbolic_ode(sysF))
# --- both -------------------------------------------------------------------------
sol = solve_epidemic(sys, sc)                              # p, initial, tspan, saveat all from the scenario
det = model_curves(sys, sol; t = sc.tgrid, label = "pairwise")   # back end
tab = compare(ref, det)                                    # D∞, z∞, ΔR∞ (95% CI), Δpeak, Δt_peak
comparisonplot(ref, det; observables = [:I, :cumulative])  # top: spread ribbon + mean + curve; bottom: residual ± 1.96 SE
```

The reference and the anchors, printed by code (rules 2 and 7):

```{julia}
anchors(sc);
describe_reference(ref);
```

```{julia}
tab
```

The largest prevalence gap is D∞ = `{julia} fmt(only(r.D∞ for r in tab.rows if r.observable === :I))`.

## The same model on a 6-regular network

```{julia}
sc6  = scenario(:sir_reg6)
ref6 = scenario_summary(sc6)
anchors(sc6);
describe_reference(ref6);
sys6 = node_based(model, sc6.network)
det6 = model_curves(sys6, solve_epidemic(sys6, sc6); t = sc6.tgrid, label = "pairwise")
tab6 = compare(ref6, det6)
```

```{julia}
#| label: fig-compare-reg6
#| fig-cap: "As above, on the 6-regular network of `:sir_reg6`."
comparisonplot(ref6, det6; observables = [:I, :cumulative])
```

On the regular network D∞ = `{julia} fmt(only(r.D∞ for r in tab6.rows if r.observable === :I))`.
